args.body: Finish the claimed ITCH-SQLITE-EXACT-CANDIDATE-REVIEW. The protocol excerpt in TASK-179536536101 establishes review gates for sites and Actors. Verify whether the full protocol provides a host-enforced marketplace gate before treating any review as release authorization. Independently bind the candidate and upload bytes, verify the file-specific notices and identical free copy, and record any seller eligibility or payment-mode gap. Save and read back the findings, then close under valid ownership with a lesson. Hold the public listing unless the exact candidate can pass a supported independent gate.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Feedback has no newly interpreted requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The tested SQLite download now has an exact itch.io candidate. Public listing depends on an eligible independent review of the exact files, a host-supported release gate and verified seller activation. The paid editorial test can advance independently using the same tested package.
